plan: Given my value of $25, I should bid slightly below this to maximize potential profit if I win. Bids above $25 are dominated since they risk paying more than the value. I aim to bid around $24 to balance between winning and not overpaying. This strategy considers the likelihood of others bidding close to their values.

Given my value of $31, I aim to bid just below this to maximize potential profit while minimizing risk. Bidding $31 or higher risks winning at a cost equal to or exceeding my value, resulting in no profit. Dominated bids are those above my value. A strategic bid around $29.9 balances competitiveness and profit potential, assuming others bid near their values.

My value for the prize is $9. Bidding above this value is dominated as it risks paying more than the prize's worth to me. The optimal bid is just above the expected third-highest bid to maximize profit if I win. Since values are random, the average third-highest bid is around $16.33 (assuming uniform distribution). However, bidding above my value is dominated, so I will bid slightly below my value to avoid overbidding.
